environment.description: Same ASP.NET Core 7.0 application deployed on Azure App Service (Linux, B1 tier) behind Azure Front Door Premium with a custom response headers policy attached to the route. The Front Door route configuration includes a Rule Set (priority 1) with a response header override action that unconditionally sets the Content-Security-Policy response header to: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'. This header override is applied as a 'Set' (overwrite) action on ALL responses matching the route pattern /api/*, meaning even if the origin application does not emit a CSP header, Front Door injects one. The rule condition is 'Always' (no request condition). Note: the application code itself still does NOT set CSP headers - the header is injected exclusively at the Front Door layer via RulesEngine. Additionally, the Front Door WAF policy associated with this endpoint has the Microsoft_DefaultRuleSet 2.1 enabled in Detection mode only (not blocking), and Bot Manager rule set is disabled.
